title: Martial Law Order 1962 Zone B No 112

sections.shortTitle: Martial Law Order 1962 Zone B No 112
sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Order 1962 (Zone B) No. 112
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW REGULATION
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ZONE `B'
No.112
[8th February 1962, Gazette
of West Pakistan,
Extraordinary,
15th February 1962]
Whereas it is expedient in the public interest to
provide for measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion and to regulate
movement of vehicular traffic in the City of Lahore.
2.
Therefore, I, Lieut-General Bakhtiar
Rana, SQA, MC, Martial Law Administrator, Zone `B',
hereby order as under :
(1)
No person, company or association plying stage carriage (s) (bus or lorry) to,
from, or through Lahore shall keep its Stand (Adda)
or use any place including a highway, road or a street within the Municipal
limits of Lahore, unless so authorised by the
Commissioner, Lahore Division for picking up or setting down the passengers or
halting the vehicle.
(2)
No Goods Carrier, except for loading and unloading goods, shall half at any
place within the Municipal limits of Lahore other than the place (s) approved
by the Commissioner, Lahore Division.
(3)
The Commissioner, Lahore Division may require the Municipal Corporation,
Lahore, to provide and maintain Bus-stand (s) at such place (s) within the
Municipal limits of Lahore as may be approved by him.
(4)
Notwithstanding anything contained in the Punjab Town Improve ment Trust Act, 1922 or any scheme sanctioned thereunder, the Commissioner, Lahore Division may direct the Lahore Improvement Trust to construct
temporary or permanent Bus-stands, and approaches and roads leading from such
Stands at any place or places within the limits of the Lahore Municipal Corporation.
(5)
In pursuance of this order the Commissioner, Lahore Division may also act as under :
(a) Acquire any land required for the Stands,
approaches and roads and eject persons forcibly on payment of such compensation
as he deems fit.
(b) Lay down the routes to be followed by any Stage
Carriage or Goods Carrier within the Municipal limits of Lahore.
(c) Regulate timings of arrival or departure of
carriages plying from, to or through Lahore.
(d) Frame rules for the administration of Bus and
Truck Stands established under this Order.
(6)
Any Stage Carriage or Goods-Carrier found plying or at halt in contravention of
the direction (s) issued by the Commissioner, Lahore Division, in pursuance of
this Order shall be impounded by an officer authorised
by him in this behalf or by any Police Officer being
not below the rank of an Assistant Sub-Inspector. Any vehicle so impounded
shall not be released except with or under the orders of the Commissioner, Lahore
Division.
(7)
Any person, association or company using a Municipal Bus-Stand in Lahore for
operating Stage Carriage (s) or using a Truck Stand maintained by the Municipal
Corporation, Lahore or using land belonging to Municipal Corporation, Lahore,
for running a Truck Stand shall pay such rent to the Municipal Corporation as
may be approved by the Commissioner, Lahore Division in this behalf. Any rent
due from any person on account of the use of a Municipal Bus Stand, Municipal
Truck Stand, or Municipal Land for Truck Stand can be recovered as arrear of land
revenue.
(8)
The Commissioner, Lahore Division, may delegate any of the powers vested in him
by this Order to the Lahore Improvement Trust, the Lahore Municipal Corporation
or the officers thereof or any officer working under him.
(9)
This Order shall be deemed to have taken retrospective effect from 1st December
1961.
(10)
The Commissioner, Lahore Division, may exempt any vehicle or class of vehicles
from the operation of any or all of these provisions.
(11)
Any person, who contravenes or attempts to contravene or abets the
contravention of this Order or any direction or directions issued by the
Commissioner, Lahore Division, in pursuance of this Order or any rule framed by
him under clause 5 (d) supra shall be punished
under C.M.L.A. Regulation No. 16 (a).
